summary: Private-user ownership and admin claims are protected, but shared-tag authorization, unpublished-data visibility, and moderation-state ownership need correction. Score applies to local Firestore rules, not the complete live infrastructure.

findings.issue: Any verified member can alter or deactivate another member's shared tag and forge creation attribution.
findings.recommendation: Bind creation attribution to auth.uid and restrict shared-tag updates to trusted moderators.

findings.issue: Tag documents have no allowed-key restriction and some fields have no application size bounds; verified image record creation has no aggregate quota.
findings.recommendation: Validate all fields and enforce aggregate creation quotas through trusted allocation.

findings.issue: Inactive profiles and unpublished image records remain public under the rules; active:false is only a directory filter.
findings.recommendation: Separate private drafts from public projections or explicitly define visibility as directory inclusion only.

findings.issue: Owners can set active:true after an administrator hides their profile, undermining use of the same field for moderation.
findings.recommendation: Use server-owned moderation state distinct from member-controlled visibility.
